links.outcome: Patient-rated readability, comprehension, usefulness, and Flesch-Kincaid score of AI plain-language summaries versus original MRI reports
links.effect: AI summaries scored significantly higher for readability, comprehension, and usefulness than original reports (all p<0.001), with equivalent trust; mean Flesch-Kincaid 66 vs 26 (p<0.001).
links.quote: AI summaries scored significantly higher for readability, comprehension, and usefulness than original reports (all p < 0.001), with equivalent trust ratings.

links.outcome: Hallucination rate and unverified recommendations in GPT-4o MRI fistula report summaries
links.effect: Hallucinations occurred in 11% of 250 outputs, with unverified recommendations also identified.
links.quote: In Phase II, hallucinations occurred in 11% of outputs, with unverified recommendations also identified.

unlisted_practices: Co-developing a standardized radiology report template with a clinician-approved lay summary section and MDT action points

screen.reason: Evaluates patient comprehension and clinician-assessed hallucinations for GPT-4o-generated radiology summaries using simulated reader testing and prompt engineering, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
